title: Immunization Services Appointment Terms — Missed-Visit Scheduling Allowance
content:
Terms of Kestrel Pharmacy Immunization Services for patients booking the next dose of a vaccination series by phone.

**Term.** When a phone appointment is set for the next dose of a series, a missed-visit allowance is taken into Kestrel's scheduling allowance. The missed-visit allowance is **2 days** where the series history shows two or more no-shows in the last 12 calendar months, **1 day** where it shows exactly one no-show in the last 12 calendar months, and nothing where it shows none.

**What counts.** A no-show is an entry on the series history recording that the patient missed a booked appointment or cancelled it after the cutoff. Only no-shows on that series history are counted. A no-show lies within the last 12 calendar months when fewer than 12 whole calendar months separate its date from today; a whole calendar month has passed once the same day number of the following month is reached.

| No-shows on the series history in the last 12 calendar months | Missed-visit allowance |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| exactly one | 1 day |
| two | 2 days |
| three or more | 2 days |

**Both sides of the 12-month line (hypothetical dates).** With today taken as 15 June of a given year:

- a no-show dated 16 June of the previous year lies 11 whole calendar months back and is counted;
- a no-show dated 15 June of the previous year lies 12 whole calendar months back and is not counted;
- a no-show dated 14 June of the previous year is not counted either.

**Illustrations (hypothetical).**

- The series history shows one no-show in March of this year and one from two years ago. Only the March no-show is counted: the missed-visit allowance is 1 day.
- The series history shows no-shows in January and April of this year. Two are counted: the missed-visit allowance is 2 days.
- The patient has no-shows only on a different vaccination course. None of them is on this series history: the missed-visit allowance is nothing.
